Shows river, mountains and some place names. Relief shown by hachures. Title from affixed label on verso. Pen-and-ink (red). A manuscript copy of a manuscript. [Copied from from Melish's map of Pennsylvania, 1822]. Stained with losses to upper left with each sheet mounted on cloth in 2 parts and mended with tape.
